name: ko_market_archetype_2026_freeze
purpose: Pre-register the fixed interpretable KO method-market archetype before reading or scoring any 2026 qualifying fights.
posthoc_context: The fourth condition (positive recent_form_win_streak_diff) was discovered during the 2025 hit/miss investigation, so 2025 is not treated as untouched validation for the finalized four-condition rule.

semantics.height_diff: priced fighter height minus opponent height, centimeters
semantics.ewm_str_acc_diff: priced fighter EWM striking accuracy minus opponent
semantics.aggression_index_diff: priced fighter aggression index minus opponent; aggression index is SPLM plus takedowns landed per 15 minutes
semantics.recent_form_win_streak_diff: priced fighter recent-form/current win-streak feature minus opponent

locked_cold_start_rule: Betting diagnostics exclude fights where either fighter has fewer than 2 prior UFC fights; probability/method allocation summaries may report all scored rows separately if needed.
selection_and_evaluation_rules: Do not change thresholds after viewing 2026.
Do not add or remove features after viewing 2026.
Do not fit a model for this test.
Primary confirmation question: among qualifying fighter-side winners, is actual KO/TKO share higher than the sportsbook fair conditional KO share assigned to that fighter winning?
Secondary diagnostics: exact KO market probability, raw odds, favorite/underdog status, weight class, scheduled rounds, and realized flat-stake ROI.
All 2026 qualifiers must be enumerated chronologically with no post-outcome exclusions.

development_falsification_summary.negative_control: Positive recent-form win-streak outside the tall+accurate+aggressive archetype had negative conditional-KO residual in every development year.
